newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Sept 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
** The lawsuit filed by Indonesian democracy figurehead Megawati Sukarnoputri against the government and political rivals resumes at the Jakarta Central District Court at 0200 GMT.

** The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 8.51 points at 5,656.90 on Wednesday as investors shrugged off news of the second U.S. military strike against Iraqi targets and awaited Friday's jobs data.
** Indonesia's consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.27 percent month-on-month in August compared to 0.68 percent in July, Information Minister Harmoko said on Wednesday.
** The Jakarta Composite Index rose 5.46 points, or 1.01 percent to 546.00 points on Wednesday on foreign buying of selected big-capitalised stocks and active local buying of small stocks.
** On Thursday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,345.50/46.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,344.50/45.50.

** Lippo Securities, Lippo Bank and Lippo Life on a news report that the capital markets supervisory agency (Bapepam) was likely to be against the proposed cross holding of shares in the three firms by majority shareholders.
** Cement firms Indocement, Semen Cibinong, and Semen Gresik on news reports of higher cement prices in various regions in the country.
** Conglomerate Bakrie & Brothers on strong first half results and talk that the firm's automotive venture would lead to positive results.
** Telecommunications and transportation firm Bukaka on the firm's announcement that it would meet its 1996 net profit forecast despite weak first half results.
